CRM notes / negotiation snapshot - shorthand and bullets:
- Account: SilverMaple (large quant asset manager). Very latency sensitive during market open windows. Primary workload: chat-like trading assistant + realtime reranking for signal pipelines. Also batch embeddings for nightly risk models.
- Requirements: 95th percentile latency SLO <= 150ms for 512-token generator under steady-state load; throughput guarantee 50 qps sustained with <5% queuing; cold-start worst-case <300ms with KV cache warm.
- Deployment: prefer Dedicated (reserved capacity) inside customer VPC with optional DR on-prem footprint. Full SOC2 + SSO/SAML + KMS integration + audit logging + 7y retention for certain logs. Data residency: US only.
- Proposed capacity: initial reserved pool = 8x A100-equivalent GPUs, autoscale policy to allow 20% burst for market spikes; planning worksheet attached (drive link).
- SLA negotiation focus: uptime %, credit schedule, maintenance windows, support response times, scheduled maintenance blackout windows during US market open. Legal explicit asks: monthly uptime >= 99.95% (target), 99.9% minimum acceptable; want credits to be meaningful.
- Proposed SLA (Redwood draft shared on call):
  * Uptime tiers: >=99.99% (no credits), 99.95%-99.99% (5% service credit), 99.9%-99.95% (10% service credit), <99.9% (25% service credit + escalation to execs)
  * Measurement: per-calendar-month, excluding scheduled maintenance with 72h advanced notice and mutually agreed blackout windows.
  * Scheduled maintenance: max 6 hours/month; customer requests up to 4 blackout hours/week (market open windows Mon-Fri 13:30-16:00 UTC). Redwood to support rolling updates with per-node draining and provide realtime status page & incident timeline.
  * Support & Response: P1 (total outage impacting reserved pool) - initial response SLA 30 minutes, 24/7 paging; P2 (severe degradation) - initial response 2 hours; P3 - next-business-day. Follow-up: runbook handoff and postmortem within 72 hours for P1.
  * Credits & remediation: credits applied as % of monthly invoice, max 50% per incident, cumulative capped at 100% in a month. Legal requested explicit credit calculation examples; Redwood to supply sample math.
- Capacity guarantees + throughput SLA: commit to average sustained 50 qps (512 tokens) with autoscaling headroom; measure with synthetic workload harness. If throughput falls below committed guarantee for 3 consecutive business hours, customer can open remediation window and request temporary additional reserved capacity or proportional credit.
- Operational expectations: Redwood to provide runbooks, escalation matrix (SE -> Oncall -> Eng lead -> AE -> Customer success), and monthly SLA review reports with token-level cost breakdown.
- POC items still open: final credit percentages, maintenance blackout enforcement mechanism, legal signoff on measurement methodology, pricing for 12-month commit with term discounts.
- Direct quote from SilverMaple legal: "Credits must be meaningful enough to offset trading risk during outages; 99.9 is borderline."
- Next steps: Redwood to deliver SLA appendix v4 with an example credit calc, confirm maintenance blackout scheduling feature, circulate redlines to SilverMaple legal by 2026-03-05.
